about: Measured on the JA Vega Joomla source (compose project javsrc, http://127.0.0.1:8261), read-only GETs, 27/09/2026. Per page: the blog cards (.items-leading / .items-row titles), the .items-more heading and link titles, the pager counter and the pager links. The source has no category blog with a third page, so no middle page could be measured: the rule it shows is that a page starts at start = (page - 1) x (leading + intro) and its More Articles titles are the ones that open the next page.
